第17章 偷袭计划
感谢上苍！传说中的兽人，果然没有哥这般勤劳！林天熟门熟路的又一次趴在了上回那个草丛里，仔细观察着对手的营地。现在6点半左右，这个时间点在剑魔大陆上，还算是睡觉时间，除少数夜间生物外，大多数种族一般都在7点左右才开始新一天的活动，兽人就在此列。此时这些兽人战士还没有起床，整个营地没有任何人活动的迹象！看样子偷袭已经成功了一半！
林天爬下小山包，动作轻巧的偷偷摸近到距营地不足百米的地方站定，按照昨晚仔细推演的预定阵型，把自己所有兵力都召唤了出来。短腿的50个矮人留在后排保护自己，毕竟若是要等行动力不高的他们跑到位，战斗可能都要结束了。前排摆放的是60名剑士和80名长枪兵，中间部分是60名精灵射手和70名弓箭手，20头狮鹫和20位飞马骑士排在两翼，负责执行第一次冲击和战斗后期的追杀。实力弱小的110名花妖也参战，但林天把安排她们在远程部队的前方，施放完一波蜂群滋扰后，就原地防御吧，可以减少珍贵射手的损失！
这么多部队纷纷凭空出现在战斗位置，本来静悄悄的兽人营地，1个兽人惊恐的大声吼叫起来，林天听懂了，这是提醒战友，有敌人，起来抵抗敌袭的意思。随即一个魔法神箭让他永远的闭上了嘴！受到初级地系魔法的加成，这个魔法已经初现威力了。某宅心里暗自懊恼，之前明明仔细侦察过没有哨兵，怎么突然就被对方发现并预警了。可能是谨慎的敌人布置了伪装很好的暗哨，就这么个小细节，让林天精心策划的偷袭变成了突袭！
突袭开始！各部队按预定计划发起冲锋，林天抓紧时间，分别对即将进入内搏的长枪兵部队和剑士部队施放了石头皮肤……
兽人军营各个帐篷马上被掀翻，一队队训练有素的兽人冲来出来，但这点时间根本不够他们组成战斗阵形，不得不以小队为单位进行抵抗。精心策划的突袭部队，所有内搏部队、射手部队、飞行部队甚至魔法骚扰，几乎同一时间发动了有效进攻，仅仅第一波的兵力对碰，有心算无心之下，就带走了半数兽人的生命。各位看官根本不用担心我们射手部队的准心，在系统法则的保护下，远程攻击和魔法攻击是不会伤害到友军的。剩余的兽人不愧是精锐，悍不畏死的发起反冲锋，林天一个激灵。
“轰！”
一道直接3、4米的巨大火柱冲天而起，把范围内的6名兽人直接烧成灰烬，同时用意念强令所有的长枪兵放弃战线，退出战场，之前已经有部分战士受了伤，现在我方局势大优，没必要把低阶的长枪兵消耗在这里，他们以后会是称职的城镇守卫者。
此时飞行部队按照指示，20个4阶飞马骑士向左，20头狮鹫向右，兵分两队，象削面条一样高速向敌人两侧掠去，带走了大片血肉。面对着足足2个等级的差距（兽人3级战力，4阶兵种是5级战力），兽人们根本无法对这些冲锋在低空、速度奇快的家伙造成伤害。精灵族飞马骑士战斗起来美感十足，速度最快的她们发动冲锋时，如同一道道残影掠过，锋利的剑尖轻易刺穿野兽们的胸膛，迅速拔出后顺势就喷出一蓬细细的血箭，冲锋结束以后她们的战斗方式就变了，改用锋利的剑刃劈砍切划，轻盈地割破一个个喉咙，如刀尖上的舞蹈。
跟飞马骑士比起来，这群狮鹫就没那么美感了，它们只有纯粹的野性和暴力。一只狮鹫从一个倒霉兽人的胸膛中，一爪抓出一颗饱满的心脏，不理会眼前这个绝望的盯住自己心脏，生命渐渐逝去的可怜兽人，冷酷的一把捏碎，头也不回的冲向另一个倒霉鬼，一啄一拉，就将这个兽人的喉咙完全破开，鲜血喷涌，显然已经没救了……飞行部队，无损！
最开始的时候，人族弓箭手甚至使用了散射特技，大片的箭雨覆盖式的打击敌人有生力量。之后就协同3阶精灵射手，精确射击。整场战斗敌人连碰都没碰到他们……射手部队，无损！
长枪兵部队已经按照指示，后退到射手部队前面摆起了枪阵。在刚才短暂的接触中，有石头皮肤保护的他们，极其幸运的都是伤而不死.
3阶剑士部队且战且退，有受伤的立刻被林天用意念微操，强制后撤，剩下的队友配合支援……肉搏部队，无损！
兽人完全无法冲过来，数量上绝对优势的精准箭雨让他们迅速崩盘，有冲锋一心求死的，也有胆怯后退保命的，但他们今天注定都要死在这里。我不需要俘虏！林天默默下令追击。

content_en:
Chapter 17 Sneak Attack Plan
Thank God! The legendary orcs are indeed not as hard-working as my brother! Lin Tian, ​​who knew the way well, once again lay down in the grass where he was last time and carefully observed his opponent's camp. It is now around 6:30, which is still considered sleep time in the Sword Demon Continent. Except for a few nocturnal creatures, most races usually start their day's activities around 7 o'clock, and the orcs are among them. At this time, these orc warriors have not gotten up yet, and there is no sign of anyone moving in the entire camp! It seems that the sneak attack has been half successful!
Lin Tian climbed down the hill, moved lightly and sneakily to stand less than a hundred meters away from the camp, and summoned all his troops according to the planned formation carefully deduced last night. The 50 short-legged dwarves stayed in the back row to protect themselves. After all, if they had to wait for them with low mobility to get into position, the battle might be over. There are 60 swordsmen and 80 spearmen in the front row, 60 elf shooters and 70 archers in the middle, 20 griffons and 20 Pegasus knights on the wings, responsible for executing the first impact and the pursuit in the later stages of the battle. The weak 110 flower demons also participated in the battle, but Lin Tianjiang arranged for them to be in front of the long-range troops. After launching a wave of swarm harassment, they could defend in place to reduce the loss of precious shooters!
So many troops appeared out of thin air at the fighting position. In the originally quiet orc camp, an orc roared loudly in fear. Lin Tian understood. This was to remind his comrades that there was an enemy and to stand up to resist the enemy attack. Then a magic arrow shut his mouth forever! With the addition of primary earth magic, this magic has begun to show its power. A certain house was secretly upset. He had carefully scouted and found no sentinels before, but why was he suddenly discovered and alerted. It may be that the cautious enemy arranged a well-camouflaged secret sentry. Just such a small detail turned Lin Tian's carefully planned sneak attack into a surprise attack!
The raid begins! The troops launched a charge according to the planned plan. Lin Tian seized the time and used Stone Skin on the spearmen and swordsmen who were about to enter the internal fight...
The tents in the orc military camp were immediately overturned, and groups of well-trained orcs rushed out. However, this was not enough time for them to form a battle formation, and they had to resist in small groups. The carefully planned assault force, all internal combat troops, archer troops, flying troops and even magic harassment, launched an effective attack almost at the same time. Just the first wave of force confrontation, calculated intentionally or unintentionally, took away the lives of half of the orcs. Readers, you don’t have to worry about the accuracy of our shooters. Under the protection of the system’s laws, long-range attacks and magic attacks will not harm friendly forces. The remaining orcs were worthy of being elites, and they launched a counterattack without fear of death. Lin Tian was shocked.
"Boom!"
A huge pillar of fire that was 3 or 4 meters straight shot up into the sky, burning the 6 orcs within the range to ashes. At the same time, he used his mind to force all the spearmen to abandon the battle line and withdraw from the battlefield. Some soldiers had been injured before. Now our situation is excellent. There is no need to consume the low-level spearmen here. They will be competent town defenders in the future.
At this time, the flying troops followed the instructions, and the 20 level 4 Pegasus knights moved to the left, and the 20 griffons moved to the right. They were divided into two teams and swept towards both sides of the enemy at high speed like cutting noodles, taking away large pieces of flesh and blood. Faced with a gap of two levels (orcs have level 3 combat power, and level 4 troops have level 5 combat power), the orcs are simply unable to cause damage to these guys who charge at low altitude and are extremely fast. The elven Pegasus knights are full of beauty when fighting. When they are the fastest, they charge, like afterimages passing by. The sharp sword tips easily pierce the chests of the beasts. After they are quickly pulled out, they spurt out a thin stream of blood arrows. After the charge, their battleThe fighting method changed, and the sharp sword blade was used to chop and slash, slicing each throat lightly, like a dance on the tip of the knife.
Compared with the Pegasus Knights, these griffins are not so beautiful. They are only pure wildness and violence. A griffin grabbed a full heart from the chest of an unlucky orc. Ignoring the poor orc who stared at his heart desperately and whose life was slowly passing away, he coldly crushed it and rushed to the other unlucky man without looking back. With a peck and a pull, the orc's throat was completely broken. Blood spurted out. It was obviously hopeless... Flying troops, no damage!
At the beginning, the human archers even used scattering stunts, covering the enemy with a large rain of arrows. Then cooperate with the level 3 elf shooter to shoot accurately. The enemy didn't even touch them during the entire battle... The shooter troops were undamaged!
The pikemen had followed the instructions and retreated to form a gun formation in front of the shooters. In the brief contact just now, protected by stone skin, they were extremely lucky to be injured and not die.
The level 3 swordsman troops fought and retreated. Those who were injured were immediately micro-managed by Lin Tian with his mind and forced to retreat. The remaining teammates cooperated to support... The melee troops were unscathed!
The orcs were completely unable to charge over, and the precise arrow rain with their absolute superiority caused them to collapse quickly. Some charged with the intention of dying, while others were timid and retreated to save their lives, but they were all destined to die here today. I don't need prisoners! Lin Tian silently ordered the pursuit.
